arguments.message:
Hi! Data that’s older than your plan’s default retention window isn’t deleted – it’s moved to cold storage and can be retrieved on request. To see what extended history is available on your current plan, go to **Settings → Reporting → Extended history**. If your plan includes a longer retention period, you’ll see it there and the data will appear on the dashboard automatically. If not, you can submit a request for the older data from that screen. Note that data that falls outside even the extended retention window may only be available if it was created after your workspace was set up.

Let me know if you need help locating the request option or have any other questions!
